name: MagenticLite (Magentic-UI)
description: Microsoft's human-in-the-loop agent app that automates browser and local file tasks using small, on-device-friendly models.
whatItDoes: MagenticLite, the successor to Magentic-UI, carries out web research, form filling and file management in one workflow while letting the user steer, approve or take over at any point.
howItWorks: A local web app pairs an orchestrator model (MagenticBrain) with the Fara browser-use model; the orchestrator plans and delegates browser actions and file operations. Users connect a model endpoint during in-app onboarding.

requirements.name: Model endpoint
requirements.description: Endpoint serving the orchestrator and Fara models, connected in onboarding

requirements.name: Python 3.12
requirements.description: Installed into a uv virtual environment

models: MagenticBrain orchestrator + Fara browser model via a hosted or local endpoint
